name: Cafetics – Elementor Addons for WPCafe
author: Arraytics

sections.description:
Cafetics is a Elementor extension that seamlessly integrates WPCafe functionality with Elementor page builder. Transform your WPCafe block into beautiful, customizable Elementor widgets for an enhanced page building experience.

Key Features

  • Elementor Integration: Convert all WPCafe shortcodes into drag-and-drop Elementor widgets
  • Easy Customization: Style your widgets directly within Elementor’s interface
  • Responsive Design: All widgets are fully responsive and mobile-friendly
  • No Coding Required: Build stunning restaurant and cafe pages without touching code
  • Real-time Preview: See your changes instantly with Elementor’s live preview
  • Professional Templates: Access to professionally designed widget templates

Widgets Included

  • Food Menu Display
  • Reservation Form
  • Restaurant Location
  • Food Categories
  • Menu Items Grid

Installation

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/cafetics directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Make sure WPCafe and Elementor plugins are installed and activated
  4. Start building your restaurant pages with Elementor!

Changelog

1.0.0

  • Initial release
